description: (Note: Potential building works nuisances during week days) A rare gem in Paris, spacious, and perfectly placed in the Triangle d’Or, just steps from Avenue Montaigne. Quiet and serene despite the central location, the apartment is filled with natural light and features a generous living area. This stylish duplex with 4-bedroom home sleeps up to 8 guests, with 4 bathroom. An elevator provides easy access, making it the perfect base for enjoying Paris’s best shopping, dining, and entertainment.The spaceStep inside this exquisite Parisian apartment and discover a haven of comfort and style. The apartment features three beautifully appointed bedrooms and a spacious living area, offering ample space for up to 8 guests. *Bedroom 1: with a comfortable double bed and an ensuite bathroom equipped with a shower and sink.*Bedroom 2: with a double bed and an ensuite bathroom featuring a shower and sink, ideal for guests seeking independence and comfort.*Bedroom 3 : the master bedroom offering a refined retreat with a walk-in dressing room, a spacious ensuite bathroom with shower, bathtub, and toilet, perfect for relaxation.*Bedroom 4 : duplex bedroom featuring a double bed, a private bathroom with shower, sink, and toilet, creating an intimate and cozy atmosphere.* The living room provides a cozy and luminous space to relax.* Four bathrooms in total, ensuring optimal comfort and privacy for all guests.* A fully equipped kitchen, featuring modern appliances and all the essentials. Enjoy the convenience of an elevator, making access easy. The apartment's design blends modern elegance with Parisian charm, creating a welcoming atmosphere for your stay.Guest accessFull access to the apartment for a fully independent stay.Other things to note* 180 sqm (1937 sq.ft)* High-speed Wi-Fi* Ele
